query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_knowledge (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  batch_number INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  batch_position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  subcategory VARCHAR(100),
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority ENUM('critical','high','medium','low') DEFAULT 'medium',
  status ENUM('pending','active','completed','archived') DEFAULT 'pending',
  use_when TEXT,
  tags VARCHAR(500),
  applied_count INT DEFAULT 0,
  last_applied_at BIGINT,
  completed_at BIGINT,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_batch (batch_number, status),
  INDEX idx_category (category),
  INDEX idx_priority (priority),
  INDEX idx_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_batches (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  batch_number INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  total_items INT DEFAULT 0,
  completed_items INT DEFAULT 0,
  status ENUM('pending','active','completed') DEFAULT 'pending',
  auto_advance TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  started_at BIGINT,
  completed_at BIGINT,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_batch_status (status)
);
